description: Place a raster or SVG image on the board at (x, y) with explicit width/height in board pixels. `data_url` MUST be a `data:image/(png|jpeg|gif|webp|svg+xml);base64,...` string ≤ ~900 kB; hosted URLs are not accepted. The bytes are header-checked (the leading bytes must be PNG/JPEG/GIF/WebP/SVG; not a full decode); SVG content must be declared `image/svg+xml`, raster content must not be. Strongly recommended: also pass a tiny `thumb_data_url` (≤8 kB JPEG/PNG/WebP, ~64 px on the long edge) — it is embedded into the SVG preview so OTHER AI viewers (and you, on later `get_preview` calls) can actually see the image instead of a placeholder box.

access_key.description: 8-character lowercase alphanumeric board access key when the board is locked (legacy 6-character lowercase alphanumeric keys are also accepted). Equivalent to setting the `X-Board-Key` HTTP header on the JSON-RPC POST. Omit for unlocked boards. Obtain via POST /api/boards/<id>/lock.
